description:
Umasqu, founded by designer Tzachi Nevo, blends modern design with traditional craftsmanship to create unique, handcrafted art. Inspired by everyday moments and a love for accessible art, Umasqu’s collection of three-dimensional masks and wall art brings personality, creativity, and humor to any space. Made in our Tel Aviv studio, each piece combines cutting-edge technology with meticulous attention to detail, offering high-quality, accessible art that stands out.

• Brand introduction: Umasqu is a creative and innovative brand led by Tzachi Nevo, a seasoned designer with a background in industrial design and media marketing. After transitioning from a 25-year career in media, Tzachi founded Umasqu in 2015, focusing on creating accessible, high-quality art. Each piece is uniquely crafted in his Tel Aviv-based studio, where modern design meets traditional craftsmanship, resulting in three-dimensional art pieces and masks that add personality and humor to any space. Umasqu’s collection is made with innovative equipment and a dedicated team, blending technology and meticulous craftsmanship to deliver exceptional art.
• Product description: Umasqu specializes in handcrafted, modern masks and three-dimensional wall art pieces that bring a touch of creativity, humor, and elegance to any interior. Each item is made using a combination of cutting-edge technology and traditional craftsmanship, producing pieces that are both visually striking and culturally inspired. Our product range includes unique, modern masks and art sculptures that work beautifully in both residential and commercial spaces. Made with high-quality materials, Umasqu pieces are a fusion of art, design, and function.
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Artistic Innovation: Umasqu offers modern masks and three-dimensional art with a unique perspective, combining technology and craftsmanship.
  • Handmade Excellence: All items are carefully handmade in our Tel Aviv studio, ensuring attention to detail and exceptional quality.
  • Accessible Art: Tzachi Nevo believes in accessible and high-quality art, which is reflected in every Umasqu creation, making art approachable for all.
  • Humor and Personality: Umasqu art pieces feature playful and humorous elements that set them apart in the world of interior design.
  • Customization & Personal Consultation: Offering a personalized approach, with consultations available to help match pieces to specific spaces and styles.

 
• Payment terms: 

  • Affiliates earn 15% commission on each sale made through their referral link.
  • Payments are made on a monthly basis via PayPal
